description: Trigger an update of the gateway itself (pull latest version, restart components). Wraps `update.run`. DESTRUCTIVE — may briefly interrupt running sessions. Confirm before calling.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

version.description: Specific version to install; omit for latest

name: openclaw_update_run
